subject.title: fix(msteams): escape markup in mention display names

question: Is the PR's loopback send-stack wire capture plus Microsoft Teams documentation sufficient proof for this narrow mention-escaping fix, or should merge wait for live Teams tenant/client render proof?
rationale: Repository policy prefers live verification for external API behavior, but the contributor cannot provide a Teams tenant artifact and the source contract plus wire proof strongly cover the payload-construction bug.

options.title: Accept contract-level proof
options.body: Treat the Microsoft Teams mention contract, current-main source reproduction, jsdom structure check, and loopback send-stack capture as sufficient for this limited escaping fix once CI is green.

options.title: Require live Teams proof
options.body: Hold the PR until a contributor or maintainer posts redacted live Teams send/render evidence showing the escaped mention works in a real tenant.

recommendation.title: Accept contract-level proof
recommendation.body: Treat the Microsoft Teams mention contract, current-main source reproduction, jsdom structure check, and loopback send-stack capture as sufficient for this limited escaping fix once CI is green.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership of the touched lines plus msteams maintenance history makes this the best available routing candidate for the proof-sufficiency choice.
